method_notes: Three navigation cycles exercise routes, then a separate bounded RSS-stability observation begins. Its original baseline, all early samples and absolute growth remain in the artifact.

Warmup samples every15s, requires3valid samples spanningatleast30s,spreadatmost512KiB and no strictly increasing consecutive RSS samples,maximum120s before starting another cycle; missingRSS or no plateau fails.
Only after an observed plateau does the full requested120second measured interval start. Existing terminal growth limits remain Core32MiB and browser postGC8MiB; they are not widened.

Linux-only optional process-status parser records Threads and anonymous/file/shared RSS, excluding names,UIDs or paths. New Linux CI outcome is separate evidence; the original CI trace lacks these fields.

RSS is not retained Python heap. Request lists/response serialization allocate transient data; no growing cache/container was found in the reviewed request path, but the allocator mechanism was not measured or proven.

Short synthetic smoke cannot exclude small/noisy/late leaks, all record sizes, real household workloads or model-loaded memory behavior. Continuous monotonic slow growth is explicitly rejected in the warmup regression.
